summary:
Our project is an Arduino-based environmental monitoring system that integrates a DHT sensor and an ultrasonic sensor to collect real-time environmental data. The DHT sensor measures temperature and humidity, while the ultrasonic sensor measures distance to nearby objects or surfaces.

The collected data is transmitted to a web-based platform where users can view and monitor sensor readings in an accessible and organized interface. By combining hardware sensors, microcontroller technology, and web development, our solution transforms physical measurements into useful digital information.

Our project aims to demonstrate how affordable and accessible technology can support real-time monitoring, improve data accessibility, and provide a foundation for smarter environmental monitoring solutions. It is designed to be simple, practical, and expandable for future applications.
details:
Our project is a real-time environmental monitoring system built using Arduino technology, designed to collect and display environmental data through an interactive website.

The system uses a DHT sensor to measure temperature and humidity, while an ultrasonic sensor measures distance to nearby objects or surfaces. Arduino processes the sensor readings and sends the collected data to a web-based platform, allowing users to monitor the measurements in real time through a simple and accessible interface.

The main benefit of our solution is making environmental data easier to collect, visualize, and understand. It offers an affordable and practical approach that can be adapted for different monitoring applications and expanded with additional sensors in the future.

We developed the project using Arduino, C/C++ programming, electronic sensors, and web development technologies (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript). Our creative approach combines low-cost hardware with a digital dashboard to turn physical measurements into accessible real-time information.

During development, our team considered affordability, accuracy, reliability, ease of use, and the possibility of future expansion. Our goal is to create a flexible foundation for smarter environmental monitoring and data-driven solutions.
